source_refs.title: iPhone battery and performance - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Battery Health; Your battery's maximum capacity
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Maximum battery capacity measures the device battery capacity relative to when it was new.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Open the Settings app, then tap Battery. Tap Battery Health. Maximum Capacity shows your battery's capacity relative to when the battery was new. Under ideal conditions, batteries of iPhone 14 models and earlier are designed to retain 80 percent of their original capacity at 500 complete charge cycles, and iPhone 15 batteries at 1000 cycles.
